key_insight: An integrated AI fiber-orientation tool reduces preparation time for crash CAE from 25 hours to 0.1 hours—a 99.6% reduction.
engineering_relevance: Crash CAE engineers can prepare orientation-dependent material inputs without molding-specialist support, improving fracture and peak-force prediction over an isotropic baseline.
method: Support injection-gate setting when gates are unknown.
Voxelize geometry, infer fiber orientation, and automatically map results to the crash CAE model.
Integrate report generation in a GUI and validate from 2D plates to production parts.
evidence_signal: Staged validation used a predefined angular-error criterion; in a component crash analysis, absolute peak-force error fell from 19.0% to 11.4%, with predicted fracture confined to the test-observed region.
watch_item: Deployment remains initial and limited to directed fracture-prediction scenarios; broader applicability is not established by the abstract.
paper_title: From AI Surrogate to Engineering Tool: Toward Production Use of Fiber-Orientation Prediction in Crash CAE
